choices: Feed monitor from IN so it retains supply when OUT is clamped. Restore100k OUT preload for regulator minimum-load requirement.
Use unused comparator half to pull the threshold low during a fault; this is deep hysteresis with low-voltage reset, not a power-cycle latch.
Reject40k/20k feedback divider: nominal off-state LED current about65uA.2M/1M reduces divider load; include bias/leakage in future hot validation.
Do not adopt diode hold: conservative reset voltage can exceed lowest forced-clamp equilibrium. PNP feedback leakage and extra logic-chip complexity are avoided provisionally.
limitations: Shunt/reference are finite-current VI surrogates, not manufacturer transient models. Startup/thermal behavior is not qualified.
LED, optocoupler and NPN models remain generic; no guaranteed delay, CTR, lifetime or reverse behavior.
Standalone imposed-OUT fixture demonstrates monitor logic, not protected supply overshoot.
Coupled operating point can initialize on fault-held branch. Resetprobe adds a diagnostic3V source to hold comparator input for20ms; this is not proposed hardware.
Startup solver aborts remain failures, not successful protection. Native files are unchanged.
done_condition: Reproducible monitor/current calculations and state fixtures with explicit coupled/startup failures; no fabrication release
human_check: Select exact hot parts/carriers, provide reliable power-on reset and reverse handling, then qualify coupled dynamics and prototype hardware
